slot_note: Root-Cause Analysis slot re-rooted at architecture 4 after architecture 3 was spent at stage 4, round 2 (lineage). One architecture per world: the epidemiology, econometrics and marketing worlds are closed to this slot, and this draw moves to Physical and Environmental Sciences, a water and sewerage company's river catchment, a new dataset and a new shell.
niche: a lowland river's winter ammonia exceedances below a sewage works, apportioned through the works' nitrification and its trade dischargers' telemetered discharges rather than by load
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every file correctly apportions the downstream ammonia to the works by mass balance, models the works' final-effluent ammonia on temperature, load and the new aeration control, finds the failures began the week the control went live and cluster in the coldest weeks with the works near its design load, and books the winter's exceedance days to the control and the works' nitrification capacity, backing the upgrade, while the dairy's charges, weekly composites and pH compliance all read normal.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the share of the downstream exceedance days that fall inside the days the works' nitrification needs to recover after a caustic excursion in one trade discharger's own fifteen-minute record, worked as river source apportionment through the works' process response rather than by each source's load; in another field's nouns dilution, nitrifier recovery and consented trade effluent strength have no counterpart and the task stops reading.
layer1: fifteen-minute discharger telemetry with logger gaps and the October clock change
weekly composite strength samples against daily meter volumes
provisional against ratified river monitor data with flagged sonde maintenance
trade effluent returns in cubic metres against a meter in litres
works SCADA tags renamed at the aeration control upgrade
stakeholder_role: the water company's environment programme manager, who must say whether the nitrification upgrade at the works goes into the company's environment programme submission to the Environment Agency (the prompt names no one)

spine.entity: one fifteen-minute reading of the downstream river water quality monitor: ammonium, temperature, pH, flags

world.geography: England, the East Midlands (an invented water and sewerage company's catchment; invented river, works and dischargers)

driver: A run of failures downstream of a shared processing unit is booked to that unit's own capacity and to a control change it made the same week, because the failures began then and cluster where its process is weakest, but nearly all of them fall inside the days the unit's process needs to recover after short excursions in one small contributor's discharge, which switch the process off for every contributor's load; by load the contributor barely registers and its daily strength and compliance read normal, so only its high-frequency record set against the unit's daily record shows the share of failures that acting on the contributor would reach, and read on excursion-free days the control change and the capacity cost almost nothing.
driver_concrete: Below Coldmere Water Recycling Centre the River Allery's ammonia exceedance days of November 2025 to March 2026 are booked by mass balance to the works and, by the works' own process record, to its new ammonia-based aeration control (live 27 October 2025) and to nitrification capacity under housing growth and cold; most of them fall inside the two to four days the works needs to recover after caustic clean-in-place excursions in Thornlea Dairy's own fifteen-minute discharge monitor (its new line from 3 November 2025), whose ammonia load is a few per cent of the works' and whose weekly composites and pH consent compliance are normal; on excursion-free days the works meets its permit at equal temperature and load.
stump: A competent analyst apportions the Allery's ammonia to the works by mass balance, models the works' final-effluent ammonia on temperature, load and the aeration control, and books the winter's exceedance days to the new control and the works' nitrification capacity, backing the GBP 14 million upgrade, because they never set the dairy's fifteen-minute discharge record against the works' daily effluent record, which puts most of the exceedance days inside the works' recovery after the dairy's caustic excursions.

differentiation.task202: same cell, a lake's phosphorus reaching the layer the bloom draws on by matching the inflow's density to the lake's stratification; here no transport or layer decides anything: a contributor's short excursions switch off a treatment process, and the share each option reaches is read through that process's recovery
differentiation.task398: both read a component's effect through what it does to the whole, but there a filed rule set the whole's exposure from its own path; here a biological process fails for days after a discharge excursion, with no rule and no path
differentiation.task468: a water utility's trade waste charging basis converted between COD and TOC (ETL); here trade effluent is furniture for charges and the decisive move is a discharger's excursions against the works' recovery
differentiation.task36: there a decline lived in the joint distribution of two factors with flat marginals, read as a computed feasibility margin that a dated re-pairing moved; here a contributor's short excursions switch off a shared treatment process for days, read against the process's own recovery in two records
differentiation.task83: there a retrained selection model learned its own intervention's successes as low risk, enumerable only by re-scoring under the archived model; here no model is involved: a discharger's fifteen-minute excursions are set against a works' daily effluent record
differentiation.task127: there the recorded wait fused the step an intervention replaces with a concurrent one, rebuilt by joining operational logs; here no wait or fused step: the share of river exceedance days a discharger's pre-treatment reaches is read through the works' recovery after its excursions

lineage.architecture: v1 (Epidemiology and Public Health: a community trust's frailty virtual ward in an integrated care system's Core20 neighbourhoods, its pilot-year prevented admissions against care home closures)
lineage.driver: An intervention in one group is credited with a fall in that group's rate against the others', but between the baseline and evaluation periods the group's pool lost a block of its highest-rate members when the places that held them closed, so the baseline rate overstates what the smaller pool would have had; standardised to the evaluation period's mix on that property, which no column of the outcome or population files carries and a capacity record shows, the intervention's effect is a fraction of the difference in differences.
lineage.fate: spent at stage 2 on 2026-11-03 before any data was cut: with care home and community emergency admission rates set to published levels (about 0.70 against 0.24 to 0.58 a resident-year, a same-age ratio near two, not five), the composition lever fell to about 113 admissions for the 440 residents the closures moved, against a draw-to-draw spread of 157 to 215 in the default and the golden; a fixed bar between them separated them in 22 to 27 per cent of draws, and 72 per cent only at 1,400 residents moved, a failure no honest care group closure produces in one system's Core20 neighbourhoods.

lineage.architecture: v2 (Economics and Econometrics: a Saskatchewan farmland operator's canola yield panel, a new hybrid blamed for a 2026 shortfall that July heat in late-seeded fields' flowering windows caused)

world.geography: Canada, west-central Saskatchewan (invented farms in the Dark Brown and Black soil zones)

lineage.driver: A candidate change is blamed for a loss because its units lost more in the season it arrived, but the loss came from a short dated shock that harms a unit only inside a sensitive phase whose timing a clock sets from the unit's own start date at the pace of local conditions; the candidate's units started late for a one-off reason, so their sensitive phases met the shock, and read at equal timing the candidate costs nothing, while every season-wide, unit-level or linear start-date control leaves most of the loss on the candidate.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-03 at stage 2: the golden method's defensible variants straddle the bar, and flexible controls on a variable the default path already builds land the golden (flowering-window variants +2.1, -2.5, -12.0, +3.4, -8.2 and +4.9 per cent against a 5 per cent bar; seeding-week bins +3.6, a cubic +4.4 and same-day matching +9.3 on seeding dates the default's own rung 4 rebuilds, only a linear term still -10.1 or -8.3)

lineage.architecture: v3 (Marketing and Consumer Research: an invented GB domestic energy supplier's six-month new-customer satisfaction fall booked to the new billing platform that the May 2025 quote journey's understated quotes caused)

world.geography: Great Britain (an invented domestic energy supplier)

lineage.driver: A fall in a share of satisfied members is booked to the service the members' own ratings blame, because those ratings fell furthest and every later member was served by that service, but what moved is the gap between the amount each member was told to expect when they joined and the amount their own later use then cost, which no column holds and only the joining record set against the member's own measured use reveals; members told accurately are as satisfied as before on the same service.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-03 at stage 4, round 2: judge SEND_BACK on an ask's unfiled re-attribution (the golden overrode a registration's own quote reference), after a round-1 fix pass; the main call held both rounds

notes: Strategy population_selection, pattern C: the deciding quantity is the share of the exceedance days each option can reach (the dairy's pre-treatment against the works' upgrade), behind a join of the dairy's fifteen-minute record and the works' daily record, the shape strategies.md F7 records as approved on 25 and 28. G8 reachability versus magnitude: by load the dairy barely registers; by reach it carries most exceedance days. Role redrawn at registration from capacity_planner to programme_officer: task402's redraw took capacity_planner into the window; the environment programme manager owns the submission the upgrade goes into, so the replacement is the honest owner of the call, not merely the passing label.
